title: Your Name.
synopsis: A country girl and a city boy begin to trade places in their dreams. As a strange connection takes shape between them, they set out to find one another across time, distance, and memory.

title: Spirited Away
tagline: A journey through a world beyond imagination.
synopsis: On the way to a new home, Chihiro wanders into a world ruled by spirits. To free her parents and return to the human world, she must find courage in a place where everything has a price.

title: Weathering with You
tagline: The weather is beautiful today. It really is.
synopsis: A runaway teen arrives in Tokyo during a season of endless rain and meets a girl with a remarkable gift: for a little while, she can clear the sky.

title: A Silent Voice
tagline: Can two people learn to hear each other?
synopsis: Years after bullying a deaf classmate, a young man seeks her out to make amends. A tender story about forgiveness, communication, and learning to face the world again.

title: Princess Mononoke
tagline: The forest remembers what we forget.
synopsis: Caught between a mining town and the ancient forest spirits who resist it, Ashitaka searches for a way forward that does not demand the destruction of either world.

title: Howl's Moving Castle
tagline: A little magic can change everything.
synopsis: A curse transforms young Sophie into an old woman. Her search for a cure leads to a wandering castle, a charming wizard, and a kind of courage she never knew she had.

title: The Boy and the Heron
originalTitle: 君たちはどう生きるか
tagline: Where do we go when we need a new world?
synopsis: Grieving and searching for his place in a changed world, Mahito follows a peculiar heron into a tower and a reality shaped by memory, loss, and possibility.

title: Suzume
tagline: The doors are closing. One by one.
synopsis: A chance meeting sends Suzume on a journey across Japan to close mysterious doors before they unleash disasters. Along the way, she finds echoes of her own past.

title: Perfect Blue
tagline: The line between the screen and the self begins to blur.
synopsis: As a pop singer reinvents herself as an actor, the boundaries between her public image and private life begin to dissolve in a psychological thriller about identity and perception.

title: Paprika
tagline: Dreams don't always stay in your sleep.
synopsis: A device that lets therapists enter their patients' dreams is stolen. A fearless dream detective follows the trail as the dream world begins to spill into waking life.

title: Millennium Actress
tagline: Every love story leaves a trace through time.
synopsis: A documentary filmmaker searches for the truth behind a legendary actress's mysterious life, only to become swept into the films and memories that shaped her.

title: Tokyo Godfathers
originalTitle: 東京ゴッドファーザーズ
tagline: Three strangers. One unexpected Christmas miracle.
synopsis: Three people living on the streets of Tokyo discover an abandoned baby on Christmas Eve and set out to find the child's parents across the city.

title: Ponyo
tagline: The sea is calling, and childhood is listening.
synopsis: A young boy rescues a curious goldfish who longs to become human, setting off a wave of magic that brings the sea and the land closer together.

title: Grave of the Fireflies
tagline: Some memories glow brightest in the dark.
synopsis: Two siblings struggle to survive in Japan during the final months of the Second World War, finding tenderness and resilience in each other.

title: My Neighbor Totoro
tagline: There are wonders just beyond the garden path.
synopsis: Two sisters move to the countryside and discover a hidden world of friendly spirits in the forest surrounding their new home.

title: The Garden of Words
tagline: Some meetings only happen in the rain.
synopsis: A student who dreams of becoming a shoemaker meets a mysterious woman in a Tokyo garden, and their quiet encounters become a refuge from ordinary life.
